Actually, let me reconsider the initial state. The original lower block was all white (100 pixels). After the first SPACE (before I knew about selectors), it became purple top + white bottom. So the default color seems to be purple.
When I selected white and pressed SPACE, the entire block became white (100 pixels). So white SPACE fills the whole block.
When I selected purple and pressed SPACE on an all-white block, it became purple top + white bottom.
So the behavior might be:
- White SPACE: fill entire block white
- Purple SPACE: paint top half purple (bottom stays as-is)
To get white top + purple bottom:
1. Fill block with purple somehow (but purple SPACE only paints top half...)
2. Then paint top half white
Hmm, maybe I need to try: select purple, SPACE (top becomes purple, bottom stays white), then SPACE again with purple (maybe bottom becomes purple now since top is already purple?).
